reproduction_target: Computational whole-genome-sequencing analysis pipeline for 686 S. aureus isolates (raw Illumina reads in ENA PRJEB59751): read QC/trimming (TrimGalore), taxonomic ID/contamination (Kraken2, Mash), de novo assembly (SKESA), reference variant calling vs NC_007795.1 (Snippy), annotation (Prokka), pangenome (Roary), core-genome phylogeny (FastTree2), MLST (ABRicate MLST), AMR gene detection (ABRicate over CARD/ResFinder/VFDB; DeepARG), SCCmec/mecA typing (staphopia-sccmec, minimap2, SCCmec_CLA workflow), spa typing (spaTyper), and pangenome-wide GWAS (Scoary). Whole pipeline implemented in CWL and executed on a local Arvados system; source/workflow/config repo at github.com/bio-ontology-research-group/mrsa-sequences.
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool from the Materials and Methods + 'Reproducibility and Implementation of FAIR Data Principles' prose of the biorxiv v3 full text (Cloudflare-blocked initially; retrieved via curl full-text, abstract cross-checked against Europe PMC PPR986271). GitHub repo landing/README (github.com/bio-ontology-research-group/mrsa-sequences) fetched at PROSE level only: contains CWL workflows/ dir, dockers/ dir, requirements.txt, setup.py, and setup instructions (virtualenv + pip install -r requirements.txt) — NOT read at workflow-source line level (that is Stage-2). Wet-lab steps (culture, VITEK-2 AST, DNA isolation, library prep, NovaSeq sequencing) counted in W, not verdicted (layer W / out of computational-reproduction scope). No R★ at stage1; RI is the ceiling.

Snippy v4.6.0 variant calling against reference genome NC_007795.1
Prokka v1.14.6 genome annotation of assembled contigs
Roary v3.13.0 pangenome construction from Prokka GFFs
FastTree2 v2.1.10 neighbor-joining/ML core-genome phylogenetic tree from core alignment
ABRicate v1.0.1 MLST assignment (MLST tool / PubMLST scheme)
ABRicate v1.0.1 AMR gene detection against CARD v5.1.1 database
ABRicate v1.0.1 AMR gene detection against ResFinder v4.0 database
DeepARG v1.0.2 deep-learning AMR gene prediction
ABRicate v1.0.1 virulence-factor detection against VFDB (no VFDB DB version/snapshot given)
minimap2 v2.24-r1122 mecA cassette detection against a local SCCmec database
SCCmec_CLA cassette-arrangement typing workflow (github.com/cdnstp/SCCmec_CLA; no version/commit pinned)
spaTyper v4.6.1 spa (protein A) typing with its associated database
Scoary pangenome-wide association study (bacterial GWAS) on Roary gene presence/absence (no version pinned)

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: RI ceiling on 15/18 computational steps — all carry exact tool version pins in the Methods prose (TrimGalore 0.4.4, Kraken 2.0.8-beta, Mash 2.3, SKESA 2.4.0, Snippy 4.6.0, Prokka 1.14.6, Roary 3.13.0, FastTree2 2.1.10, ABRicate 1.0.1 [x4 uses incl. CARD 5.1.1, ResFinder 4.0], DeepARG 1.0.2, staphopia-sccmec 1.0.0, minimap2 2.24-r1122, spaTyper 4.6.1) plus a CWL/Arvados workflow with source+config+dockers/ dir claimed available. 3/18 steps cap at NI: VFDB virulence DB has no version/snapshot, the SCCmec_CLA external workflow is unpinned (no commit), and Scoary carries no version. Container/CWL execution-environment preservation is CLAIMED (dockers/ dir + 'execution environments preserved') but UNVERIFIED at stage1, so version axis is capped at 1 (exact pins without validated closure); no step exceeds RI without an executed environment capture. R★ not assignable at stage1.
headline.coverage: 18 computational steps assessed from biorxiv v3 Methods prose + repo README prose. 6 wet-lab steps (TSA culture/ID, VITEK-2 AST, KingFisher DNA isolation, QIASeq FX library prep, Illumina NovaSeq 6000 sequencing, sample collection) counted (W) but out of computational-reproduction scope; raw reads (ENA PRJEB59751) are the reproducible entry point.
